runtimeNotes: Every card mapping includes source node IDs and original source geometry; no full-board image is embedded.
Use stable entity IDs for matched routes and gulets. For sortOrder changes, move complete source card groups; do not only replace text/image while leaving the source slot identity fixed.
Source page order differs from current CMS sortOrder for some route collection layouts.
Current source has no status badge node. If status is added to entities, renderer must decide hide/show behavior.
Entities beyond source node count require cloning the first semantic card group using image/title/link nodes and device-specific grid spacing.
The four experience source cards use stable CMS IDs and canonical sourceDefaults. When entity values equal these defaults, preserve the board-specific source artwork.
